reviews.author: Chady Majady
reviews.text: Absolutely love your grooming service! You never disappoint. My cats always come out looking fresh, clean, and calm. It’s amazing how relaxed they are after every appointment, with no stress or anxiety at all. Thank you for always taking such great care of them ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Алёна Ломовцева
reviews.text:
We have been regularly visiting the grooming salon and our master Tom groomer for six months now, and our Pomeranian Spitz absolutely adores our groomer! The services here are of exceptional quality, and each visit leaves the most positive impressions. The groomer is attentive to every comment and request, allowing us to always achieve the perfect result.

Every time we leave completely satisfied, as the grooming is performed at the highest level! Our Spitz always looks stunning and well-groomed, as if straight off a magazine cover.

We don't just suggest, but strongly recommend this grooming salon to all our friends and acquaintances. Unique professionalism, individual approach, and care for the pet - this is what makes these services incredible. We are confident that we will continue to visit this wonderful groomer for many years to come.

reviews.author: Валентина Чекмазова
reviews.text: Thank you very much for cat! She becomes even more beautiful and fluffy 🥰 job done very good, even I would say perfectly 👍 endlessly grateful for my cat! I think she is also happy to not have hairball anymore 🙈

reviews.author: Shaik Hussain
reviews.text: In a world where your furry friends deserve only the best, Pet Love is the epitome of care and quality. Imagine a place where every wag of a tail and every snarl of satisfaction is answered with expert hands and a heart full of compassion. At Pet Love, they transform grooming from a menial task to an enjoyable experience, ensuring your pets leave at salon not only looking great, but feeling loved.

reviews.author: John Rafael Dejarme
reviews.text: Pet love is a great place to go for services for your pets because they provide excellent quality of service to their clients and the staff is also customer and pet-friendly and they also offer many products to choose from! My dog is always excited to go there! Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Hann Villar
reviews.text: My Pomeranian boy just had his first haircut, and voala!!! I'm thrilled with the outcome. Huge thanks to Kuya Tom for doing such an amazing job. He took great care of our Cosmo and showed incredible patience with this naughty and stubborn boy!

reviews.author: Justine Villanueva
reviews.text: Taking Oscar to his first grooming appointment in Dubai was a bit nerve-wracking, but Kuya Tom at Petlove did an amazing job! We stayed at the store the whole time to make sure Oscar was comfortable. The establishment was very clean, and it was reassuring to see that they had a doggy daycare and in-house pets. It was a positive experience overall! 🥰🙌🏽

reviews.author: Nezaiah Joyce
reviews.text: I’m really impressed with this pet shop. The staff took the time to explain everything I needed to know and helped me choose the right items for my pet. The store is clean, organized, and the animals are clearly well taken care of. Great customer service and good prices. I’ll definitely come back again!
